metaDesc: Electric Man: rotate the cables and bring power from the transformer to every house. A 3D puzzle game with 300 levels. TusneldaX.
aBoard: Game board: tap a cable to rotate it
noGL: Couldn't open the 3D scene. Your browser may not support WebGL.
i1: Hi! Tap a cable and I'll come connect it. Get power from the transformer to every house. Tap me to switch characters.
i2: Use the direction button below to choose which way the cables turn.
i3: From this level on, there's a move limit. Fewer moves, more stars!
i6: New: bolted cables don't turn. Plan your solution around them.
i9: New: broken cable! Tap it once to fix it, then rotate it.
i40: New: clouds! You'll only see the cable under a cloud once power reaches it.
iLast: Final level! Show off all your skills.
iDistrict: Welcome to {d}! Let's light it up.
iRand: Come on, let's turn on the lights!
Start at the transformer and work out along the branches.
Think backwards from the houses: each one has just one connection.
Edge cables are the easiest, start there.
Switching direction can sometimes save you a move.
